command.description: Native tool from the pinned NVIDIA GROMACS distribution; not a shell command.

nonempty.description: Exclude zero-byte matches from this argument only. Defaults to true for trjcat/eneconv -f input selectors, false elsewhere. Explicit false includes empty files. All files remain in checkpoints and outputs. An expansion with no eligible files is an error.

args.description: Exact argv tokens, or a {files: relative-pattern} expansion. trjcat/eneconv -f selectors skip zero-byte segments by default; all other selectors include them. directory.description: Working directory relative to the extracted input bundle.

stdin.description: Explicit newline-separated interactive selections, e.g. Protein\n0\n. EOF follows; no interactive terminal.

restart_checkpoint.description: Optional native .cpt path relative to directory. Missing files are errors, never a silent fresh simulation.

plumed_input.description: PLUMED input file relative to directory for an mdrun step. Uses the packaged kernel; GROMACS passes native checkpoint/restart events to PLUMED. Include all bias/restart files in the input bundle when continuing an external run.

expected_outputs.description: Files relative to directory which must exist and be nonempty after this command. Do not use globs.

threads.description: OpenMP threads per single thread-MPI rank, within the initial eight-vCPU execution shape.

checkpoint_minutes.description: Native .cpt write cadence. A local checkpoint alone does not survive node loss.

segment_minutes.description: MD stops cleanly at this wall-time interval to publish a coherent checkpoint and closed output segment; then resumes with -noappend. Native neighbor-search boundaries can delay the stop.

max_wall_seconds.description: Cumulative workflow execution budget in seconds (default and maximum fourteen days), including checkpoint I/O. Exhaustion preserves a coherent native checkpoint and reports WORKFLOW_TIME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, not scientific success. Explicit continuations and infrastructure retries retain the original parameters and subtract saved elapsed execution time; resuming does not renew an exhausted budget.

max_output_bytes.description: Optional explicit cap on retained workspace bytes, including inputs and outputs. Omit to use available authorized storage without an additional workflow cap. Execution scratch and customer bucket capacity still apply; native files and output cadence are preserved.

output_destination.description: Copy coherent native checkpoints and trajectory segments into the submitting user's assigned tenant/user bucket, as well as durable platform artifacts. output_prefix.description: Customer-bucket prefix. The platform appends operation ID and replica ID, so independent runs cannot overwrite each other.

target_id.description: Optional named upstream target configuration for the selected variant. Choose either target_id or an explicit target. The target_catalog describes each named configuration and its required bundle_path; names are not inferred from filenames.

diffusion_steps.description: Required explicit denoising step count; never silently replaced. The pinned upstream model_sampling baseline is 400 steps. Its 100-step example is a quick local test, not equivalent quality: shorter sampling trades runtime for potentially severe raw-backbone distortion, particularly for ligand-target and AME. Choose explicitly and inspect raw/refolded geometry; successful execution does not guarantee useful designs. This API does not infer a default.

target.description: Explicit customer target configuration. This replaces target_id and accepts any structure and constraints supported by the selected upstream variant; it is not restricted to target_catalog examples. Upload bytes using the normal tenant-owned target-bundle artifact and manifest.

bundle_path.description: Relative path to the target structure inside your authenticated target-bundle tar (for example inputs/my-target.pdb or inputs/my-target.cif). No absolute paths, parent traversal, links, or .fs2 control paths.

binder_length.description: Explicit fixed length [N] or inclusive range [minimum, maximum]. Equal endpoints also select a fixed length. No scientific length is inferred from a catalog.

pdb_id.description: Optional reference identifier; does not fetch or replace the supplied structure.

target_input.description: Protein chains/residue ranges from the supplied structure, for example A1-150, A1-100,B1-50, or A. All hotspots must lie in the selected residues.

hotspot_residues.description: Exact chain/residue identifiers, for example A45 and B67. Empty means no hotspot guidance. Missing or ambiguous requested hotspots fail explicitly.

ligand.description: Ligand residue name or list of names. With ligand_only=false, select the named residues from the supplied structure. With ligand_only=true, the entire file is the ligand; names do not crop it.

ligand_only.description: True uses the entire input structure as the ligand. False selects target.ligand residue names.

use_bonds_from_file.description: Use input-file bonds. False requires SMILES and one ligand.

contig_atoms.description: Explicit fixed motif atoms, for example A64: [O, C]; A86: [CB, CA, N, C]. Every selected atom must exist in the supplied structure.

output_prefix.description: Directory in your assigned bucket for automatic result.json, artifacts and manifest.json delivery. Defaults to runs/<model-id>; the operation ID is appended. Never sent to the model.

continuation_files.description: Generated by the checkpoint-resume endpoint: verified input artifact IDs mapped to native workspace paths. Use :resume rather than assembling these by hand. Files stream directly from object storage to the worker.

jobs.description: One distributed workflow with ID gang; every mdrun uses the complete admitted MPI gang. Preparation and analysis run once on rank zero.

command.description: Native tool from the pinned NVIDIA GROMACS distribution; not a shell command.

nonempty.description: Exclude zero-byte matches from this argument only. Defaults to true for trjcat/eneconv -f input selectors, false elsewhere. Explicit false includes empty files. All files remain in checkpoints and outputs. An expansion with no eligible files is an error.

args.description: Exact argv tokens, or a {files: relative-pattern} expansion. trjcat/eneconv -f selectors skip zero-byte segments by default; all other selectors include them. Set nonempty explicitly to override. Raw files are retained. Patterns must match eligible existing files. No shell expansion. Do not include gmx or platform-managed mdrun flags.

directory.description: Working directory relative to the extracted input bundle.

stdin.description: Explicit newline-separated interactive selections, e.g. Protein\n0\n. EOF follows; no interactive terminal.

restart_checkpoint.description: Optional native .cpt path relative to directory. Missing files are errors, never a silent fresh simulation.

expected_outputs.description: Files relative to directory which must exist and be nonempty after this command. Do not use globs.

threads.description: OpenMP threads per MPI rank/GPU, up to eight per rank within the admitted CPU envelope.

checkpoint_minutes.description: Native .cpt write cadence. A local checkpoint alone does not survive node loss.

segment_minutes.description: MD stops cleanly at this wall-time interval to publish a coherent checkpoint and closed output segment; then resumes with -noappend. Native neighbor-search boundaries can delay the stop.

max_wall_seconds.description: Cumulative workflow execution budget in seconds (default and maximum fourteen days), including checkpoint I/O. Exhaustion preserves a coherent native checkpoint and reports WORKFLOW_TIME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, not scientific success. Explicit continuations and infrastructure retries retain the original parameters and subtract saved elapsed execution time; resuming does not renew an exhausted budget.

max_output_bytes.description: Optional explicit cap on retained workspace bytes, including inputs and outputs. Omit to use available authorized storage without an additional workflow cap. Execution scratch and customer bucket capacity still apply; native files and output cadence are preserved.

output_destination.description: Copy coherent native checkpoints and trajectory segments into the submitting user's assigned tenant/user bucket, as well as durable platform artifacts. Customer objects are retained until the customer deletes them or applies their bucket lifecycle; the platform never silently deletes them.

output_prefix.description: Customer-bucket prefix. The platform appends operation ID and replica ID, so independent runs cannot overwrite each other.

nodes.description: Distinct admitted nodes. One node uses a single multi-GPU Pod; multiple nodes use a gang. The product of nodes and gpus_per_node must not exceed sixteen.

gpus_per_node.description: GPUs and MPI ranks per node. Defaults to one GPU per node. All ranks are part of one simulation, not independent replicas.

request_schema.description: Distributed upstream GROMACS 2026.2 CUDA/Open MPI workflows. One MPI rank per GPU, with one to eight GPUs per admitted node and at most sixteen GPUs total; preparation and analysis run on rank zero. The operator-qualified shape selects local CUDA-aware MPI, cross-node TCP, or InfiniBand UCX RDMA on a configured GPU cluster; transport and device allocation are not request overrides. This is not the NVIDIA NGC binary. PLUMED, CP2K, Torch NNPot and coupled replica exchange are not exposed by this execution shape.
